script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Mars in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction in your relationships. Meanwhile, Venus trines your 10th House of Career, offering a smooth path for professional advancement. Saturn's square to your 3rd House of Communication adds a layer of seriousness to your daily conversations. If you're single, the cosmic current invites you to express your dreamy vulnerability, drawing in someone who appreciates your depth; if you're taken, watch for miscommunication with your partner as Mercury squares your 5th House of Romance. Your 2nd House of Income receives a supportive sextile from Jupiter, suggesting a sudden financial boost or a lucrative opportunity at work. Beware: the Moon's opposition to your 1st House may amplify self-doubt, so guard your confidence. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
